decisions.reason: A burner component that extends the established radiant heater line is cheap to carry, supports the core business, and needs no problemistic search.
As a flagship electric line aligned with the decarbonisation direction and shown on its own page, it likely meets aspirations and benefits from slack in an R&D-intensive firm.
The halogen infrared heater is a low-cost extension of the electric portfolio with no evidence of a shortfall, though it could be consolidated into the broader electric lines later.
This industrial hall heater sits close to the core offer and serves established industrial and logistics customers, so it likely performs at aspiration.
The hydrogen-ready flagship is already in real operation and central to the firm's strategic direction, so management will carry it despite uncertain early results.
